summary: The live web sidebar renders the roster as the accessible folder tree with the shared sidebar toolbar. Press / to search and ArrowDown to enter matching results; free text matches agent names and IDs, repo:, state: and tool: match reported facts, and machine: or host: still filter host prefixes. Needs me, finished agents and sort apply only to this browser's view, matching names are highlighted, clearing search reveals the selected agent, and empty results offer a clear-filters action

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Web client only; no protocol, harness or CLI change. Free text in the live sidebar no longer matches host names: use machine:dev3 or host:dev3 to filter by host. The live sidebar query and filters are now kept per gateway in the browser's existing sidebar settings. fractal-ui additively exports SidebarTree and its props, item and handle types from assistant-ui/shell.
